arabic_text: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
transliteration: yā man tuḥallu bihī ʿuqadu al-makārih
english_text: O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
transliteration: wayā man yufthaʾu bihi ḥaddu al-shadaʾid
english_text: O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
transliteration: wa yā man yultamassu minhu al-makhraj ilā rūḥi al-faraj
english_text: O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!

arabic_text: ذَلَّتْ لِقُدْرَتِـكَ الصِّعَابُ وَتَسَبَّبَتْ بِلُطْفِكَ الاسْبَابُ ، وَجَرى بِقُدْرَتِكَ الْقَضَاءُ وَمَضَتْ عَلَى إرَادَتِكَ الاشْياءُ ،
transliteration: ḏallat li-qudratika al-ṣṣiʿāb wa tasabbabat bilutfika al-asbabu wa jarra bi-qudratika al-qada' wa-madat ʿala irādatika al-ashyāʾu
english_text: Intractable affairs yield to Thy power, means are made ready by Thy gentleness, the decree goes into effect through Thy power, and all things proceed according to Thy desire.

arabic_text: فَهْيَ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ دُونَ قَوْلِكَ مُؤْتَمِرَةٌ ، وَبِإرَادَتِكَ دُونَ نَهْيِكَ مُنْزَجِرَةٌ.
transliteration: fa-hiya bi-mashiyyatika duna qawlika mu'tamiratun wa bi-irādatika dūna nahyika munzajirah
english_text: By Thy desire they follow Thy command without Thy word and by Thy will they obey Thy bans without Thy prohibition.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الْمَدْعُوُّ لِلْمُهِمَّاتِ ، وَأَنْتَ الْمَفزَعُ فِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ،
transliteration: anta al-madʿū lilmuhimmāt wa-anta al-mafzau fi al-mulimmat
english_text: Thou art the supplicated in worries and the place of flight in misfortunes;

arabic_text: لاَيَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا دَفَعْتَ ، وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
transliteration: lā yandafiʿu minha illā mā dafaʿta walā yankašifu minhā illā mā kašafta
english_text: none of them is repelled unless Thou repellest, and none is removed unless Thou removest.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ، وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
transliteration: waqad nazala biyya rabbī mā qad tak'adaniyya thiqluhu wa'alamma biy mā qad bahathanī ḥamluhu
english_text: Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.

arabic_text: وَبِقُدْرَتِكَ أَوْرَدْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَبِسُلْطَانِكَ وَجَّهْتَهُ إليَّ.
transliteration: wa bi-qudratika awradtahu ʿalayya wa bisulṭānik(a) wajjah(t)a(hu) ʾilayy(a)
english_text: Through Thy power Thou hast brought it down upon me and through Thy authority Thou hast turned it toward me.

arabic_text: فَلاَ مُصْدِرَ لِمَا أوْرَدْتَ ، وَلاَ صَارِفَ لِمَا وَجَّهْتَ ، وَلاَ فَاتِحَ لِمَا أغْلَقْتَ ، وَلاَ مُغْلِقَ لِمَا فَتَحْتَ ،
transliteration: fala musdar lima awradta wa lā ṣārifa limā wajjah-ta walā fātihalimā aghlaqta wa laa mughliqa lima fatahta
english_text: None can send away what Thou hast brought, none can deflect what Thou hast turned, none can open what Thou hast closed, none can close what Thou hast opened,

arabic_text: وَلاَ مُيَسِّرَ لِمَا عَسَّرْتَ، وَلاَ نَاصِرَ لِمَنْ خَذَلْتَ
transliteration: walā muya'ssira limā ʿassart walā nāṣira liman khaḍalt
english_text: none can make easy what Thou hast made difficult, none can help him whom Thou hast abandoned.

arabic_text: فَصَلَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ، وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ، وَاكْسِرْ عَنِّيْ سُلْطَانَ الْهَمِّ بِحَوْلِكَ ، وَأَنِلْيني حُسْنَ ألنَّظَرِ فِيمَا شَكَوْتُ ،
transliteration: faṣalla ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waftaḥ liyā, yā rabbi, bāba al-faraji biṭawlik wakssir ʿannī sultāna alhammi biḥawlika wa'anilni husna al-naẓari fi ma shakawtu
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Thy graciousness, break from me the authority of worry by Thy strength, confer the beauty of Thy gaze upon my complaint,
let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
transliteration: wa habli min ladunka rahmatan wa farajan hani'an wa-jaʾl li min ʿindika makhrajā waḥiyyā
english_text: give me from Thyself mercy and wholesome relief, and appoint for me from Thyself a quick way out!

arabic_text: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
transliteration: wa lā tašġalnī bi-l-ahtimām ʿan taʿāhudi furūḍika wa istiʿmāli sunnatika
english_text: Distract me not through worry from observing Thy obligations and acting in accordance with Thy prescriptions.

arabic_text: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ، وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ، وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ ، وَدَفْعِ مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ ،
transliteration: faqad ḍiqtu limā nazala bī yā rabbidharaʿan wa 'imtalat bi-ḥamli mā ḥadatha ʿalayya hammāً waanta alqadiru ʿala kashfi ma munitu bihi wa-dafʿi mā waqaʿtu fīh
english_text: My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me, and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me, while Thou hast power to remove what has afflicted me and to repel that into which I have fallen.

arabic_text: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ، يَا ذَا العَرْشِ الْعَظِيمَ.
transliteration: fa'fʿal biy dhālika wa'in lam astawjibhu minka yā dhā al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm
english_text: So do that for me though I merit it not from Thee, O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!
